en.summary: Primarily fixes simx packet-dispatch semantics for multi-pid traces so the execution model preserves the correct fragment ownership and SOP/EOP boundaries.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly identifies a simx dispatcher bug.
The changed files are central execution-model files, not logging or CLI plumbing.
The dispatcher hunk directly changes how one trace is split into modeled execution packets.
disqualifiers: The commit is broad and also changes cache, core, scoreboard, utility, and CSR-definition code.
This is a simulator-model fix rather than an RTL fix.
evidence: sim/simx/dispatcher.h now reuses the original trace for the final fragment instead of cloning every fragment.
The fix assigns pid, sop, eop, and tmask after deciding whether a new trace object is needed.
The old path deleted the original trace when the final fragment was sent.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When an execution model splits one decoded trace into multiple packet-id fragments, the final fragment must keep the correct ownership and boundary flags. If the dispatcher clones every fragment and mishandles the last fragment, SOP/EOP state or the thread mask can attach to the wrong object and modeled execution diverges from hardware packetization.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: multi-fragment trace packetization in the execution model
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: One decoded trace must be emitted as multiple packet-id or lane-group fragments.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore the policy that clones every fragment and mishandles final-fragment ownership or boundary-flag assignment.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: duplicate final fragment or misplace boundary flags
portability_notes: Apply this to any instruction-accurate or cycle-accurate model that splits vector or packet traces before modeled execution.
The reusable bug is incorrect ownership and boundary handling of the final fragment.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the model code that splits one trace into multiple sub-traces.
Always allocate a fresh trace for each fragment instead of reusing the original for the last fragment.
Recreate the old final-fragment ownership path so SOP/EOP or tmask can attach to the wrong trace object.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Dispatcher packet splitting for multi-pid traces
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix clones only intermediate fragments, reuses the original trace for the last fragment, and assigns pid, sop, eop, and tmask on the correct object before dispatch.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the old dispatcher path that always allocates a new trace and deletes the original trace when the final fragment is emitted.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The model can duplicate, drop, or mis-boundary part of a multi-pid trace, causing simulated execution to diverge from intended hardware behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix code always allocated a new pipeline_trace_t for pid fragments.
The fix starts from new_trace = trace and only clones non-final fragments.
Boundary and mask assignment now happens after that ownership decision.
notes: This is a model-side injection, which still qualifies here because simx is used as a hardware-behavior model.
The same commit fixes other simulator semantics, but the dispatcher split is the cleanest isolated injection point.

zh.summary: 该提交主要修复了 simx 中多 pid trace 的分发语义，使执行模型能够保留正确的分片所有权以及 SOP/EOP 边界。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确指出这是 simx dispatcher bug。
被修改的文件都是核心执行模型文件，而不是日志或 CLI 基础设施。
dispatcher 的补丁直接改变了一条 trace 被拆成多个执行包的方式。
disqualifiers: 该提交范围较大，同时还修改了 cache、core、scoreboard、工具函数和 CSR 定义。
这是 simulator 模型修复，而不是 RTL 修复。
evidence: sim/simx/dispatcher.h 现在会让最后一个分片复用原始 trace，而不是为每个分片都克隆新对象。
修复把 pid、sop、eop 和 tmask 的赋值放在决定是否分配新对象之后。
旧路径会在发送最终分片时删除原始 trace。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当执行模型需要把一条已解码 trace 拆成多个 packet-id 分片时，最后一个分片必须保留正确的对象所有权和边界标志。如果 dispatcher 对每个分片都克隆新对象并错误处理最后一个分片，就可能把 SOP/EOP 状态或线程掩码附着到错误对象上，从而让模型执行偏离硬件应有的包化语义。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 执行模型中的多分片 trace 包化逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条已解码 trace 必须被拆成多个 packet-id 或 lane-group 分片。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复对每个分片都克隆对象、并错误处理最终分片所有权或边界标志赋值的策略。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: duplicate final fragment or misplace boundary flags
portability_notes: 适用于任何在送入模型执行单元之前需要切分 vector 或 packet trace 的指令级或周期级模型。
可复用缺陷的本质是最终分片的对象所有权和边界处理错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把单条 trace 拆成多个子 trace 的模型代码。
不要让最后一个分片复用原始对象，而是对每个分片都重新分配一份 trace。
恢复旧的最终分片所有权路径，使 SOP/EOP 或 tmask 可能附着到错误对象。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 多 pid trace 的 Dispatcher 分片逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复只为中间分片分配克隆对象，让最后一个分片复用原始 trace，并在 dispatch 之前把 pid、sop、eop 和 tmask 赋给正确对象。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的 dispatcher 路径：每个分片都新建一份 trace，并在发出最后一个分片时删除原始 trace。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 模型可能重复、丢失或错误划分多 pid trace 的一部分，从而使模拟执行偏离硬件应有行为。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前的代码会为每个 pid 分片都分配新的 pipeline_trace_t。
修复后先执行 new_trace = trace，只为非最后一个分片分配克隆。
边界与掩码赋值现在发生在这一所有权决策之后。
notes: 这是模型侧注入，但在这里仍然有效，因为 simx 承担的是硬件行为模型角色。
同一提交还修复了其他 simulator 语义，但 dispatcher 分片是最干净的隔离注入点。
